import platform_ops as p
src={'PATH':'/x','NO_PROXY':'localhost'}

print('LEAKED',sorted(bad&set(e)))
assert not (bad&set(e))
assert 'NO_PROXY' in e
print('OK injected proxy+secret names scrubbed, NO_PROXY preserved')
